title: Soft drink, fruit flavored, caffeine containing, diet

content.title: About
content.content: A diet soft drink with fruit flavor and added caffeine, designed for those who want a refreshing beverage without sugar while still getting a mild energy boost.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Fruit flavor is often derived from natural extracts but may also contain artificial flavorings.
Caffeine in diet drinks typically ranges from 30 to 80 mg per serving.
Diet versions use low‑calorie sweeteners such as sucralose or stevia instead of sugar.
The first fruit‑flavored caffeinated soft drink appeared in the 1970s in the United States.
Some brands release limited‑edition exotic fruit flavors like passion fruit or hibiscus.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: Caffeine stimulates the central nervous system, increasing alertness and concentration.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: Diet versions usually contain fewer than 5 kcal per 100 ml, helping to control overall energy intake.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: The drink is primarily water, supporting the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Vitamin profile
items.content: Some fruit variants are fortified with vitamin C and other antioxidants.

items.title: Sugar‑free
items.content: Absence of sugar makes it suitable for people with diabetes or those following low‑carb diets.

items.title: Caffeine sensitivity
items.content: Some individuals may experience anxiety, insomnia, or rapid heartbeat after caffeine consumption.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: These may cause digestive discomfort in people with sensitive stomachs.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Fruit flavor can increase acidity, potentially irritating the stomach lining if consumed in excess.

items.title: Medication interactions
items.content: Caffeine can amplify the effects of certain drugs, such as stimulants or antidepressants.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Serve chilled, preferably in moderate amounts – no more than 250‑300 ml per day. It can replace sugary sodas or act as a light pre‑workout energizer.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 7‑10 days.
